description: This file defines the HibernateAdministrationDAO class, which implements database operations specific to Hibernate for the OpenMRS Administration Service. It includes methods for managing global properties, executing raw SQL, validating entities, updating PostgreSQL sequences, and integrating with Spring's ApplicationContext.

classes.name: HibernateAdministrationDAO
classes.description: Hibernate-specific implementation of the AdministrationDAO interface, providing methods for configuration, property management, validation, and database sequence synchronization within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory used by this DAO.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a global property by name.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyObject
methods.description: Fetches the GlobalProperty object for a given property name from the database, considering case sensitivity settings.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a GlobalProperty entity by its UUID.

methods.name: getAllGlobalProperties
methods.description: Returns a list of all GlobalProperty entities, ordered by property name.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesByPrefix
methods.description: Fetches global properties whose names start with the given prefix.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesBySuffix
methods.description: Fetches global properties whose names end with the given suffix.

methods.name: deleteGlobalProperty
methods.description: Deletes a specified GlobalProperty from the database.

methods.name: saveGlobalProperty
methods.description: Creates or updates a GlobalProperty in the database.

methods.name: executeSQL
methods.description: Executes a raw SQL query, returning the results as a list of object lists.

methods.name: getMaximumPropertyLength
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum length allowed for a specific property field within an entity class.

methods.name: setApplicationContext
methods.description: Injects the Spring ApplicationContext to facilitate bean access.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates an entity object for property length constraints and custom validators.

methods.name: getValidators
methods.description: Fetches registered validators applicable to a given object.

methods.name: isDatabaseStringComparisonCaseSensitive
methods.description: Determines if string comparison in the database is case-sensitive based on global properties.

methods.name: updatePostgresSequence
methods.description: Updates PostgreSQL sequences for identity columns to match the current maximum IDs.
